Safe Smart Account contracts v1.4.1 from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@safe-global/safe-contracts/-/safe-contracts-1.4.1.tgz

Only the dependency closure for SafeL2, SafeProxyFactory and MultiSend is used.
Unused upstream examples, handlers, libraries, accessors and tests were omitted.
Retained Solidity sources are unmodified. Upstream LICENSE is included.
Source: https://github.com/safe-global/safe-smart-account/tree/v1.4.1
